questions.question: What is matter made of?
questions.explanation: All matter is composed of atoms.

questions.question: True or false: Electrons are found in the nucleus of an atom.
questions.explanation: Electrons orbit around the nucleus.

questions.question: Describe the difference between an element and a compound.
questions.explanation: Elements are pure substances, while compounds are bonded atoms.
questions.sampleAnswer: Elements are made of one kind of atom; compounds are bonded atoms of different elements.

questions.question: Match the form of energy with its source.
questions.explanation: Each form of energy has a unique origin.
